## What you did

- You got prod PG17 cutover ready: blue/green Terraform on the prod instance (replica now follows the swap instead of being recreated — plan is 2 changes, 0 destroys), the runbook in `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md`, and PR #321 opened with Maya as reviewer [1][3].
- You rehearsed the whole blue/green on a snapshot clone: 74 seconds of write downtime, replication lag under 1 s, dashboards API reconnected without restarts — then tore the clone down to stop the cost [1].
- You corrected the runbook on rollback: after switchover the blue instance diverges, so rollback is not just switching back [1].

## What changed

- The window moved: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night, so the cutover is now **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**. Maya confirmed it and says you can update the runbook and merge #321 [8][10].
- Maya approved #321, with the condition not to merge before the window was confirmed — that's now lifted [3].
- Daniel Levi will be on call for the API side on Sunday; ping him when you start the switchover [7].
- Lior Ben-David confirmed the ingest workers need nothing (SSM-based DATABASE_URL), but asked for 30 min notice before switchover to pause consumers cleanly [9].

## What is still open

- Rollback rehearsal on a fresh clone is scheduled for **Thursday 19/11** — measure duration and data loss, keep it in the runbook as a todo [1].
- Update the runbook to the Sunday window before merging #321 [8][10].
